guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：次級離子質譜儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: Secondary-ion mass spectrometers
guides.concept: 從一次離子的碰撞級聯與二次離子化機率出發，理解 SIMS 為何能偵測 ppb 等級的摻雜卻受基質效應支配，再把靜態與動態模式、一次離子源、磁扇與飛行時間質量分析、植入標準片的靈敏度因子校正、偵測極限、電荷補償與濺射坑效應整合成可驗收的深度剖析工程。
guides.conceptEn: Start from the collision cascade of primary ions and the secondary ionisation probability to see why SIMS detects ppb-level dopants yet is ruled by matrix effects, then integrate static and dynamic modes, primary ion sources, magnetic-sector and time-of-flight mass analysis, sensitivity-factor calibration with implant standards, detection limits, charge compensation and crater effects into an acceptable depth-profiling record.
procedure: 能量 0.25 到 30 keV 的一次離子打進固體後引發碰撞級聯，把動量傳回表面，使最上面一到兩個原子層的原子被濺射出來；每個一次離子濺射出的原子數稱為濺射產率 Y，典型為 1 到 10。被濺射的粒子只有一小部分帶電，離子化機率 α⁺ 或 α⁻ 從 10⁻⁵ 到 10⁻¹，而且強烈依賴表面化學：O₂⁺ 轟擊或氧氣吹掃把表面氧化，大幅提高正離子產率；Cs⁺ 降低表面功函數，提高負離子產率。這種基質效應是 SIMS 定量困難的根源，也是它靈敏度極高的來源。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「碰撞級聯與二次離子」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

靜態 SIMS 把一次離子總劑量限制在約 10¹² 到 10¹³ ions/cm²，遠低於表面一個單層的 10¹⁵ atoms/cm²，使大多數分析區域在被量到時仍未被先前的離子損傷，因此能保留分子碎片與完整分子離子的資訊，適合有機表面與單層分析。動態 SIMS 刻意用高劑量連續濺射，以每秒零點幾奈米的速率剝除材料並持續記錄各質量的強度，把時間軸換算成深度軸，用於半導體摻雜分佈與多層膜的深度剖析。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「一次離子劑量與靜態極限」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

動態 SIMS 常用雙電漿管產生 O₂⁺、表面離子化源產生 Cs⁺，束流從 nA 到 µA、束徑數微米到數十微米，追求高濺射速率與穩定電流。靜態與影像 TOF-SIMS 用液態金屬離子源產生 Bi⁺、Bi₃⁺ 等團簇，亮度高到能聚焦到 50 nm 以下，而團簇離子把能量分散在表面淺層，二次離子產率比單原子離子高一個數量級。氣體團簇離子源（Ar₁₀₀₀⁺ 到 Ar₅₀₀₀⁺）每個原子只帶幾 eV，低於原子位移閾值，能剖析有機多層而不累積化學損傷。離子柱包含質量過濾、靜電透鏡、偏轉與掃描板，並配備法拉第杯量束流。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「O₂⁺/Cs⁺ 離子槍與 Bi 液態金屬離子源」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

二次離子被數 kV 的萃取電場收集後送入質量分析器。雙聚焦磁扇儀器（靜電扇加磁扇）在高傳輸率下提供 m/Δm 數千到上萬的解析度，可連續監測少數幾個質量，是動態深度剖析的主力；飛行時間分析器在一次脈衝內記錄全部質量，搭配反射鏡可達 m/Δm 30 000 以上，適合靜態與影像分析；四極桿簡單便宜但解析度只到單位質量。質量解析度的實際意義在分離同標稱質量的干擾，例如 ³¹P⁺ 與 ³⁰Si¹H⁺、⁵⁶Fe⁺ 與 ²⁸Si₂⁺，而干擾的強度往往比痕量元素高幾個數量級。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「磁扇與飛行時間質量分析器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

因為基質效應，SIMS 定量必須靠與未知樣品相同基質的標準片：把已知劑量的元素離子植入矽、鍺或 GaAs，以相同條件剖析，積分訊號對深度即可得到相對靈敏度因子 RSF，定義為濃度 = RSF × (痕量離子強度/基質離子強度)。深度尺度來自濺射坑深度與時間的線性換算，坑深以觸針輪廓儀或干涉儀量測；當剖析跨越不同材料層時，各層的濺射速率不同，必須分段校正。RSF 隨一次離子種類、能量、入射角與氧氣吹掃條件改變，所以標準片必須在同一個分析配方下量測。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「離子植入標準片與 RSF」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

二次離子以電子倍增器脈衝計數偵測，強訊號改用法拉第杯以避免飽和，兩者在重疊區交叉校正，動態範圍可達 8 到 9 個數量級。偵測極限由背景決定：殘氣吸附的 H、C、O，離子柱與腔壁的記憶效應，質量干擾的拖尾，以及倍增器的暗計數。痕量元素的計數遵循 Poisson 統計，訊號必須高於背景的 3σ；延長每個資料點的停留時間或增加一次束流都能改善，但束流增加同時加快濺射，深度解析度與總分析時間隨之改變。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「電子倍增器計數與背景」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

深度剖析的解析度受三個因素限制：一次離子把原子推向更深處的離子混合，深度約為投影射程的 2 倍；濺射造成的表面粗糙化；以及濺射坑壁斜面持續貢獻尚未剖析到的淺層訊號。低能量（250 eV 到 1 keV）與斜入射減少混合，旋轉樣品抑制粗糙化，電子閘控只接受來自掃描區中央一小部分的二次離子以排除坑壁。絕緣樣品在正離子轟擊下累積正電荷，二次離子能量偏移、訊號消失，必須以低能電子槍中和，負一次離子（O⁻）或 TOF 的脈衝電子中和也是常用手段。整合這些機制與腔體真空、樣品台精度，才能同時達到奈米深度解析與 ppb 靈敏度。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「濺射坑、電子閘控與電子中和槍」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

SIMS 的性能完全綁定在分析配方上：一次離子種類、能量、入射角、束流、掃描尺寸、閘控比例、質量解析度、氧氣吹掃與中和條件任一改變，RSF、偵測極限與深度解析度都隨之改變。驗收因此以配方為單位：每個配方用植入標準片驗證 RSF 的重現性、用 δ 層樣品驗證深度解析度、用高純矽驗證偵測極限、用質量雙峰驗證解析度、用絕緣樣品驗證中和。交接文件把每個配方的參數、對應標準片、驗收結果與趨勢圖綁在一起，任何人換配方時必須重走驗收流程。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「參考樣品組與配方紀錄」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: Primary ions of 0.25 to 30 keV entering a solid start a collision cascade that returns momentum to the surface and sputters atoms from the top one or two atomic layers; the number of atoms sputtered per primary ion, the sputter yield Y, is typically 1 to 10. Only a small fraction of the sputtered particles are charged, with ionisation probabilities α⁺ or α⁻ from 10⁻⁵ to 10⁻¹ that depend strongly on surface chemistry: O₂⁺ bombardment or oxygen flooding oxidises the surface and greatly raises positive-ion yields, while Cs⁺ lowers the surface work function and raises negative-ion yields. This matrix effect is the root of SIMS quantification difficulty and also the source of its extreme sensitivity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Collision cascade and secondary ions”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Static SIMS limits the total primary-ion dose to roughly 10¹² to 10¹³ ions/cm², far below the 10¹⁵ atoms/cm² of a surface monolayer, so most of the analysed area is still undamaged by earlier ions when it is sampled; molecular fragments and intact molecular ions survive, which suits organic surfaces and monolayers. Dynamic SIMS deliberately sputters continuously at high dose, removing material at a fraction of a nanometre per second while recording the intensity of each mass, converting the time axis into depth for semiconductor dopant distributions and multilayer profiles. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Primary-ion dose and the static limit”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Dynamic SIMS commonly uses a duoplasmatron for O₂⁺ and a surface-ionisation source for Cs⁺, with beams from nanoamperes to microamperes and diameters from a few to tens of micrometres, aiming at high sputter rate and stable current. Static and imaging TOF-SIMS use liquid-metal ion sources producing Bi⁺ and Bi₃⁺ clusters bright enough to focus below 50 nm, and cluster ions deposit their energy in a shallow layer so secondary-ion yields exceed those of monatomic ions by an order of magnitude. Gas-cluster sources (Ar₁₀₀₀⁺ to Ar₅₀₀₀⁺) carry only a few electronvolts per atom, below the atomic displacement threshold, and profile organic multilayers without accumulating chemical damage. The column holds a mass filter, electrostatic lenses, deflection and raster plates, and a Faraday cup for current measurement. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “O₂⁺/Cs⁺ guns and Bi liquid-metal ion source”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Secondary ions collected by a several-kilovolt extraction field enter the mass analyser. Double-focusing magnetic-sector instruments (electrostatic plus magnetic sectors) provide m/Δm of thousands to tens of thousands at high transmission and monitor a few masses continuously, the workhorse for dynamic depth profiling; time-of-flight analysers record all masses from each pulse and with a reflectron exceed m/Δm of 30 000, suiting static and imaging work; quadrupoles are simple and cheap but reach only unit mass resolution. Mass resolution matters for separating isobaric interferences such as ³¹P⁺ from ³⁰Si¹H⁺ or ⁵⁶Fe⁺ from ²⁸Si₂⁺, where the interference is often orders of magnitude stronger than the trace element. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Magnetic-sector and time-of-flight analysers”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Because of the matrix effect, SIMS quantification relies on standards with the same matrix as the unknown: a known dose of the element is ion-implanted into silicon, germanium or GaAs and profiled under identical conditions, and integrating the signal over depth yields the relative sensitivity factor RSF, defined by concentration = RSF × (trace-ion intensity/matrix-ion intensity). The depth scale comes from a linear conversion of crater depth and time, with the crater depth measured by a stylus profilometer or interferometer; when a profile crosses different material layers each has its own sputter rate and must be calibrated separately. RSF changes with primary-ion species, energy, incidence angle and oxygen flooding, so the standard must be measured under the same analytical recipe. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Ion-implanted standard and RSF”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Secondary ions are detected by pulse counting on an electron multiplier, with a Faraday cup taking over for strong signals to avoid saturation and the two cross-calibrated in their overlap, giving a dynamic range of 8 to 9 orders of magnitude. The detection limit is set by background: H, C and O adsorbed from residual gas, memory effects from the ion column and chamber walls, tails of mass interferences and the multiplier's dark counts. Trace counts follow Poisson statistics and the signal must exceed 3σ of the background; longer dwell per data point or higher primary current helps, but higher current also sputters faster, changing depth resolution and total analysis time. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Electron-multiplier counting and background”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Depth resolution is bounded by three effects: ion mixing that pushes atoms deeper, to about twice the projected range of the primary ions; sputter-induced surface roughening; and the sloping crater walls that keep contributing shallow signal not yet profiled. Low energy (250 eV to 1 keV) and oblique incidence reduce mixing, sample rotation suppresses roughening, and electronic gating accepts secondary ions only from a central fraction of the raster to exclude the walls. Insulators charge positively under positive-ion bombardment, shifting secondary-ion energies and killing the signal, so a low-energy electron gun neutralises them; negative primary ions (O⁻) or pulsed electron flooding in TOF instruments are common alternatives. Integrating these mechanisms with chamber vacuum and stage precision is what delivers nanometre depth resolution together with ppb sensitivity. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Crater, electronic gating and electron flood gun”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

SIMS performance is bound to the analytical recipe: changing the primary species, energy, incidence angle, current, raster size, gate fraction, mass resolution, oxygen flooding or neutralisation changes the RSF, detection limit and depth resolution. Acceptance is therefore organised per recipe: each recipe verifies RSF reproducibility on an implant standard, depth resolution on a δ-layer sample, detection limits on high-purity silicon, resolution on a mass doublet and neutralisation on an insulator. The handoff binds every recipe's parameters, its matching standards, acceptance results and trend charts together, and anyone who changes a recipe must repeat the acceptance sequence. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Reference-sample set and recipe records”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 在氧化層與矽的界面，氧覆蓋突然改變使 α⁺ 跳變數倍，深度剖析在界面出現假的濃度峰或谷；若不認識這個基質效應，會把儀器假象報告為界面偏析。
把矽基質的 RSF 套用到 SiGe 或 GaAs，濃度誤差可達數倍；深度剖析跨越氧化層時若沿用矽的濺射速率，氧化層被錯算得太厚或太薄，摻雜峰位置全部錯置。
pitfallsEn: At an oxide–silicon interface the sudden change in oxygen coverage jumps α⁺ by several times, so depth profiles show a false concentration peak or dip at the interface; without recognising the matrix effect this artefact is reported as interfacial segregation.

Applying a silicon-matrix RSF to SiGe or GaAs produces concentration errors of several times; carrying the silicon sputter rate through an oxide layer misplaces the oxide thickness and shifts every dopant peak position.

related.title: X 光光電子能譜儀
related.transfer: 可遷移「濺射、離子化機率與有用產率」與「相對靈敏度因子與深度尺度校正」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；X 光光電子能譜儀的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Sputtering, ionisation probability and useful yield" and "Relative sensitivity factors and depth-scale calibration" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of X-ray photoelectron spectrometers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦濺射與離子化機率、有用產率、質量解析、相對靈敏度因子與深度剖析的痕量分析工程；X 光光電子能譜儀則以光電子結合能、非彈性平均自由徑、單色器與半球分析器的表面化學分析工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on sputtering and ionisation probability, useful yield, mass resolution, relative sensitivity factors and depth-profiling engineering for trace analysis; X-ray photoelectron spectrometers centres on photoelectron binding energy, inelastic mean free path, monochromator and hemispherical analyser engineering for surface chemistry, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「碰撞級聯與二次離子」與「光電子動能與結合能」的輸入、輸出與主要干擾。

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 次級離子質譜儀
history.text: 1949 年 Herzog 與 Viehböck 在維也納首次以質譜分析濺射出的二次離子；1960 年代 Castaing 與 Slodzian 在奧賽建立離子顯微鏡，1968 年由 CAMECA 商品化為 IMS 300，Liebl 則發展出離子微探針；1969 年 Benninghoven 在明斯特提出靜態 SIMS，1980 年代結合飛行時間分析器，1989 年 ION-TOF 成立。1990 年代後半導體摻雜剖析成為動態 SIMS 的主要應用，CAMECA 的 NanoSIMS 把橫向解析度推進到 50 nm，團簇離子源則打開有機與生物樣品的分析。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1949 Herzog and Viehböck in Vienna first analysed sputtered secondary ions by mass spectrometry; in the 1960s Castaing and Slodzian at Orsay built the ion microscope, commercialised by CAMECA as the IMS 300 in 1968, while Liebl developed the ion microprobe; in 1969 Benninghoven at Münster introduced static SIMS, combined it with time-of-flight analysers in the 1980s, and ION-TOF was founded in 1989. From the 1990s semiconductor dopant profiling became the main application of dynamic SIMS, the CAMECA NanoSIMS pushed lateral resolution to 50 nm, and cluster ion sources opened organic and biological analysis. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「濺射、離子化機率與有用產率」到「儀器驗收、配方控制與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Sputtering, ionisation probability and useful yield" through "Instrument acceptance, recipe control and engineering handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
